conf.description: Cisco FTD LINA VPN/AAA syslog carried as an SNMP trap (CISCO-SYSLOG-MIB), direct route: maps the decoded varbind envelope to ECS. Per-message-ID body parsing (username, tunnel-group, assigned IP) is out of scope for this format block - not in the catalog's field list, see README gap.

conf.comment: cisco-ftd / lina-vpn-aaa / snmp-trap. Input assumed JSON from the trap receiver (varbind names as keys). Only envelope fields the catalog lists are mapped; the LINA message body (113xxx/605xxx/722xxx) still needs the syslog-raw pipeline's grok, not reproduced here to avoid guessing patterns not supplied.

functions.description: record scope and the message-body gap
ECS dataset tag; no _time step - clogHistTimestamp is sysUpTime ticks, not wall-clock, so _time is intentionally left to the trap receiver's arrival time per the catalog
batch-rename the mapped/already-resolved envelope fields to ECS
MIB severity enum is offset by one from raw syslog 0-7 (constraint: subtract one); flag 254-byte truncation (trailing '*') per catalog so an analyst knows a 722xxx string was clipped
